about.title: About
about.description: Addable Labs' mission and approach: AI-native, a senior person in charge, agents as staff, building in the open.
about.lead: An AI-native software company from Sweden. We build apps and tools where AI is part of the product and part of how the work gets done: agents plan, implement and review, and a senior person is in charge of every decision that matters. We share what we learn along the way — and help people and teams become as much at home with AI as we are.
about.missionText: Addable Labs exists to show that AI agents can be real colleagues — and to make that way of working available to more people. That means shipping software built this way, in the open, with honest accounts of what worked and what did not; helping individuals and teams find their footing with AI; and starting new products only when the job is clearly one for a team of agents.
about.approachHeading: How we work and what we stand for

aiNative.title: AI-native
aiNative.text: AI is part of what Addable Labs builds and part of how it builds: the products on this site were made largely with AI agents, and the company's own work is organised around them.

team.title: A senior person, agents as staff
team.text: A senior person sets the direction, makes the decisions that matter and reviews the result; agents plan, implement and review the work in between. Keeping the team that small keeps the decisions close to the work.

open.title: Building in the open
open.text: The public repositories carry their own documentation and, where an experiment did not live up to its brief, an honest evaluation of what it produced. The blog records the lessons as they happen. We would rather say what did not work than make it look better than it was.
